card.name: The g in gram units after a number
card.fires_on: The letter g (gram) right after a number in lab thresholds, mostly hemoglobin values such as 8 g/dL or 11 g/dL. Also fires on g after a protein amount.

modes.label: Hemoglobin thresholds
modes.description: The g after a hemoglobin cutoff number, before /dL.
modes.example: Withhold WELIREG until hemoglobin ≥8<< g>>/dL. Resume WELIREG

modes.label: Protein amounts
modes.description: The g after a number for protein intake or urine protein.
